lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters organized into distinct vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a coordinates-based structural pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs is visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near the anterior and basal regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct elongated silhouettes representing commensal remoras (Echeneidae) are attached to the shark: one on the dorsal ridge anterior to the first dorsal fin, one on the mid-lateral flank, and one near the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
